integrity: The two-sided bracket is proved from the exact Möbius fixed-point conjugacy and an exact three-point Aitken identity. The stable-side threshold is proved analytically and sharpness is supplied for every unstable plant gain by an explicit positive-parameter family. The embedded verifier checks symbolic identities and exact witnesses only.
scientific_limitations: Scalar time-invariant Kalman covariance recursion; nonzero observation coefficient; positive process and measurement variances; lower initial covariance; exact arithmetic. Matrix Riccati equations, over-starts, recursive use of the extrapolate, and finite-precision covariance consistency are not classified.
title: Scalar Kalman Riccati Aitken brackets and the exact open-loop stability boundary
